2608.19966.title: Rethinking Patch Based Multivariate Time Series Forecasting with Semantic Structured Partitioning
2608.19966.paper_summary: Multivariate time series forecasting (MTSF) is a fundamental task in many real world applications. Existing patch based forecasting methods generally fall into three categories: fixed partitioning, multi-scale partitioning, and extendable partitioning. Fixed partitioning often breaks meaningful temporal boundaries, multi-scale partitioning may introduce redundant representations across scales, and extendable partitioning improves flexibility but still lacks an explicit mechanism for organizing semantic structure and modeling interactions among heterogeneous temporal patterns. To address these limitations, we propose SCPaT, a Transformer based framework built on semantic structured partitioning. SCPaT first decomposes input sequences into semantically consistent units through adaptive semantic unit generation, then constructs a dynamic semantic graph to model directed dependencies among these units and organize them into higher order semantic blocks. Based on these structured representations, an importance aware routing mechanism adaptively dispatches different semantic blocks to different experts for customized modeling. Extensive experiments on 12 real world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of SCPaT.
2608.19966.paper_summary_zh: 多變量時間序列預測（MTSF）是許多現實世界應用中的一項基本任務。現有的基於補丁的預測方法通常分為三類：固定劃分、多尺度劃分和可擴展劃分。固定劃分往往會打破有意義的時間邊界，多尺度劃分可能會在不同尺度之間引入冗餘表示，而可擴展劃分提高了靈活性，但仍然缺乏明確的機制來組織語義結構和建模異質時間模式之間的互動。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了SCPaT，一個基於Transformer的框架，建立在語義結構劃分之上。SCPaT首先通過自適應語義單元生成將輸入序列分解為語義一致的單元，然後構建一個動態語義圖來建模這些單元之間的有向依賴關係，並將它們組織成更高階的語義區塊。基於這些結構化表示，一個重視重要性的路由機制自適應地將不同的語義區塊分派給不同的專家進行定制建模。在12個現實世界數據集上的廣泛實驗證明了SCPaT的有效性。
